seasonalNotes: Transplant tomato and pepper after the last frost date in your USDA zone.
Cucumber beetles emerge alongside the first true leaves — monitor early.
Apple scab pressure rises with cool, wet springs; black-spot peaks on roses in humid summer weeks.
farmerFriendlyGuidance: Mulch tomato beds and water at soil level to reduce splash-borne blight.
Rotate cucurbits to a new bed each year to limit cucumber-beetle carryover.
Hand-pick beetles off rose blooms early in the morning to keep populations low without sprays.
